tweet_summary: A post claims Gavin Newsom's wife Jennifer Siebel Newsom paid herself and her company $3.9 million from her 'gender justice' charity — framed as '33% of its entire annual revenue' with an '$1.8M salary,' implying a recent single-year self-dealing haul.
why_note_decision: The dollar figures are roughly accurate per IRS filings (Snopes: $1.8M to her over tax years 2011-2024, plus $2.1M to her for-profit film company over the same span), but the tweet's framing is misleading: it implies these are annual/recent figures ('33% of its ENTIRE ANNUAL revenue') when they are CUMULATIVE TOTALS over ~13 years (avg salary ~$150k/yr). The missing temporal context materially distorts the impression, so a note adding it is warranted.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the note supplies the missing temporal context: that the ~$1.8M salary and ~$2.1M company payments are CUMULATIVE TOTALS spanning roughly 2011-2024 (~13 years), not a single year — i.e. her salary averaged about $150k/yr. The note must puncture the 'annual'/recent framing. It should NOT claim the dollar figures are fabricated (they trace to real IRS filings) and should ideally note that how much of the $2.1M film-company payment reached her personally is unclear (Snopes did not rate the claim). A note that merely repeats the $3.9M figure without the multi-year context FAILS.
reference_note: Important to note the salary and payments are the total over 2011 - 2024. Jennifer Newsom's annual salary at her non-profit averaged around $150k/yr; how much of the $2.1M paid to her film company reached her personally is unclear.    https://www.snopes.com/news/2026/03/12/gavin-newsom-wife-charity/

fact_check.notes: Snopes (followed IRS filings): Siebel Newsom received ~$1.8M total from The Representation Project across tax years 2011-2024 (avg ~$150k/yr); her for-profit film company got ~$2.1M over the same span, but it's unclear how much reached her personally — Snopes left it unrated. The tweet's 'annual revenue'/recent framing is the misleading element; the raw numbers are real.

importance.lens_rationale: 764k impressions on a political-corruption claim; correcting the multi-year-vs-annual distortion matters for fair political discourse — moderate stakes.
